true.meaning: Yes: a sentence other than the plan says what causes the problem.
examples: Our nightly backups time out because they copy 2 TB over a 50 Mbit/s link. I've decided to send only changed blocks.

false.meaning: No: the only sign of a cause is in the plan itself, or there is none.
examples: Our booking API returns errors at peak. I've decided to raise the database connection pool limit.
Our push notifications arrive late. I've decided to flush the notification batch every minute instead of every three hours.
